name: io.github.mbj733/dsh-subagent-mcp
description: Delegate a one-shot task to a fresh DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agent from any MCP host. Inherits the user's AGENTS.md, skills and sign-in; two explicit cost tiers (lite ~9k tokens, full ~300k).

environmentVariables.name: DSH_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to the DSH home directory that holds AGENTS.md, skills and credentials. Defaults to ~/.dsh.

environmentVariables.name: DSH_SUBAGENT_MAX_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Maximum concurrent delegated runs. Defaults to 2.

environmentVariables.name: DSH_SUBAGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Default hard timeout per run in seconds. Defaults to 1800.
